verdict.rationale: Reader's own GitHub docs say requests can be routed through its hosted proxy with the `x-proxy: auto` header. That pool rotates residential and datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges, which matches the story directly. The evidence is a single first-party mention that requires an API key. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of proxy options (e.g. geo-targeting or bring-your-own proxy, rotation behavior) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the rotation avoids blocks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks

citations.quote: Route through the SaaS proxy with `-H 'x-proxy: auto'` (key required). Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.
